Since registrations do not state detailed personal needs, the team will offer the alternative to everyone without asking for unnecessary explanations.

Each area will have a reference person. Before the day begins, they will go over the changes together and take down the old signs. There will also be a table for comments at the end of the tour. Success will be judged by the clarity of the information and the chance to take part, not only by the number of visitors who come through the door.
